'''Caleb's hut''' was a small hut located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] that was home to the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]], [[Caleb]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] first traveled to Caleb's hut in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] after he had been poisoned by [[Githany]].<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> There, he forced Caleb to heal him by threatening to kill [[Serra|the man's daughter]].<ref name="JvS 1" /> After healing Bane, Caleb forced his daughter to leave the planet forever and change her name so that Bane could never threaten her again,<ref name="PoD" /> and she eventually became the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Doan]].<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

In [[990 BBY]], Bane and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], returned to Caleb's hut. Zannah was forced to strike a deal with Caleb to get him to heal her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] again, who was dying from wounds acquired during a [[Duel on Tython|recent duel]] with four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. She was forced to send a [[message drone]] to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], informing them of a helpless [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] currently on Ambria. However, Zannah then [[Death/Legends|killed]] Caleb, drove her cousin, [[Darovit]], [[Summon fear|insane]] with her [[Sith sorcery/Legends|sorcery]], and [[Spell of concealment|hid]] herself and Bane in a trapdoor in Caleb's hut. When a [[Ambria strike team|team]] of Jedi arrived, they were [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by Darovit, who they quickly killed, believing him to be the Sith Lord to which the message referred.<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Caleb was later honored, alongside the Jedi who Bane and Zannah had killed on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], on a monument in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="DoE" />

In [[980 BBY]], Serra traveled to the Jedi Temple on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after a series of diplomatic incidents on Doan between the [[mining caste]] and the [[Doan Royal House]]; the most recent being a [[Massacre on Doan|massacre]] in which a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]], had been killed. There, she was shown the monument which mentioned her father's name. Believing that Bane had returned and killed her father, she hired an [[Darth Cognus|assassin]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] him and bring him to Doan, where she interrogated the Sith Lord in the [[Stone Prison]]. Serra's friend and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], was disturbed by Serra's anger and freed Bane&mdash;who she had fought alongside in the [[Gloom Walkers]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]&mdash;although Lucia was soon after killed by Zannah. Serra then initiated the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]] of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in an attempt to kill Bane and Zannah, before finding the dead body of her friend and fleeing to the hut on Ambria. There, Serra [[Burial/Legends|buried]] Lucia and realized the error of her ways; she realized that her father would never have wanted her to become so vengeful. Bane, however, along with his new apprentice, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Cognus&mdash;the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] that Serra had hired to capture him&mdash;tracked Serra to Ambria and found her at Caleb's hut, where Cognus killed her.<ref name="DoE" />
